page: Vultr voc-s-32c-256gb-5760s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The hardware configuration is bundled with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and a local 5760 GB NVMe SSD. No GPU accelerators are included.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, passmark CPU score, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory bandwidth is a notable strength, with both large-block read and write operations reaching the top 10% tier. Single-core performance, measured via Geekbench and stress-ng single-core tests, falls within the middle 50% average. Cryptographic operations and extended instruction tests also register in the top 25%, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instruction sets.

The server offers high resource density, combining substantial memory capacity with a large local NVMe storage footprint on a dedicated CPU platform. This resource balance makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-throughput local storage and large memory spaces without the overhead of external storage attachments. This configuration is suited for database operations, software compilation, memory-intensive data processing, and medium-scale language model text generation.
